t: 家族办公室Ceniarth公开十年“影响力优先”成绩单：四年净IRR仅3.2%
s: 8亿美元家族办公室Ceniarth揭露：十年投入逾3亿美元影响力优先资金，涵盖约90档基金与60笔直投，近四年净IRR 3.2%，扣除费用与通膨后实质约为零。罕见透明数据，可作家族配置基准。
te: Family office Ceniarth reveals break-even results from its impact-first portfolio
se: Ceniarth, an $800m family office, has deployed over $300m of impact-first capital across about 90 funds and 60 direct deals. Its four-year net IRR was 3.2%, roughly zero after costs and inflation; breaking even needs about 4.5% gross. Rare, candid data for families sizing impact allocations.

t: MacArthur基金会影响力投资额度扩大50%至7.5亿美元
s: MacArthur基金会将影响力投资配置提高50%至7.5亿美元，2027年起执行，回收资金滚动再投资，并延长至少6%捐赠支出承诺至2028年。大型基金会加码，显示影响力投资已成慈善常备工具。
te: MacArthur Foundation lifts its impact investment pool 50% to $750 million
se: The MacArthur Foundation is raising its impact investment allocation by 50% to $750m, starting in 2027, with repaid capital redeployed into new deals. It also extended its pledge to pay out at least 6% through 2028. A major foundation scaling up signals impact investing is now a core philanthropic tool.

t: Candide旗下气候正义基金募得7,150万美元，放款给社区型绿能开发商
s: Candide Group的Afterglow气候正义基金募得7,150万美元，以弹性债权支持银行不愿承作的小型绿能开发商；MacArthur等以次顺位债承担风险，已放款3,500万美元，示范慈善资本为商业资金铺路。
te: Afterglow Climate Justice Fund raises $71.5 million for community clean-energy lending
se: Candide Group's Afterglow Climate Justice Fund raised $71.5m against a $100m ceiling to lend flexibly to small, first-time clean-energy developers banks avoid. Foundations including MacArthur provide subordinated debt; $35m is already lent. A blended structure showing how catalytic money can pave the way for commercial capital.

t: 南韩推K-GX绿色转型战略，十年动员1,000兆韩元
s: 南韩公布K-GX战略，十年动员1,000兆韩元（约7,470亿美元），其中570兆韩元为政策性气候金融，230兆韩元预期来自民间；锁定钢铁、石化、半导体减碳，再生能源目标100GW。与台湾产业结构相近，值得对照。
te: South Korea unveils K-GX strategy to mobilise 1,000 trillion won for green transformation
se: Seoul's K-GX strategy aims to mobilise 1,000tn won (about $747bn) over ten years: 200tn from budgets, 570tn in state-backed climate finance and 230tn from private projects. It targets steel, petrochemicals and chips, plus 100GW of renewables. A close benchmark for Taiwan's similar industrial mix.

t: 香港发行200亿港元数码绿色债券，创全球数位债最大规模
s: 香港特区政府定价约200亿港元（26亿美元）数码绿色债券，分港元、人民币、美元、欧元四档，认购倍数1.3至11.3倍，并首度以代币化存款完成港元档交割。绿色金融结合代币化，巩固香港作为亚洲永续资本枢纽的地位。
te: Hong Kong prices record $2.6 billion digital green bond
se: Hong Kong priced about HK$20bn ($2.6bn) of digital green bonds, the largest digital bond yet, in HKD, RMB, USD and euro tranches, 1.3 to 11.3 times subscribed. Tokenised deposits were used to settle the HKD tranche, merging green finance and tokenisation in Asia's sustainable capital hub.

t: 挪威主权基金NBIM承诺12亿欧元投入CIP旗舰再生能源基金
s: 挪威石油基金管理机构NBIM承诺12亿欧元投入CIP第六代旗舰基金，该基金据报目标160亿欧元，投资北美、西欧与亚太再生能源及储能。主权资金持续押注能源转型基础建设。
te: NBIM commits €1.2 billion to CIP's new flagship clean energy fund
se: NBIM, manager of Norway's roughly $2tn oil fund, committed €1.2bn (about $1.34bn) to Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners' CI VI, which reportedly seeks €16bn for renewables and storage across North America, Western Europe and Asia Pacific. Sovereign money keeps backing transition infrastructure.

t: 美SEC结束调查BlackRock、State Street，但警告参与气候倡议恐触法
s: 美SEC决定不对参与Climate Action 100+的BlackRock、State Street采取执法行动，但警告被动投资人协同议合可能被视为持股逾5%的“集团”，丧失简易申报资格，恐冷却跨机构气候议合。
te: SEC drops BlackRock, State Street probe but warns on climate group participation
se: The SEC will not pursue enforcement against BlackRock, State Street and others over Climate Action 100+, but warned that coordinated engagement could make large passive investors a 'group' holding over 5%, costing them simpler Schedule 13G filing status. A likely chill on collective climate stewardship.

t: Robeco调查：82%投资人预期十年内实体气候风险将冲击资产价格
s: Robeco调查300位、合计逾35兆美元资产的投资人：82%预期十年内实体气候风险将影响资产价格，63%认为五年内将左右策略性资产配置，42%计划一年内加码气候解方。气候已成定价问题。
te: Robeco survey: 82% of investors expect physical climate risks to hit asset prices within a decade
se: Robeco's survey of 300 investors managing over $35tn across Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific and South Africa found 82% expect physical climate risks to affect asset prices within ten years and 63% see strategic asset allocation affected within five. 42% plan to add climate-solution exposure within a year.

t: Aviva Investors与荷银注资1亿欧元，扩大循环混凝土平台SL Materials
s: Aviva Investors与荷银永续影响力基金合投1亿欧元于SL Materials，从拆除混凝土回收砂石与水泥再制新料并扩充产能。水泥约占全球二氧化碳排放8%，循环建材成影响力资金新标的。
te: Aviva Investors, ABN AMRO invest €100 million in circular concrete platform SL Materials
se: Aviva Investors and ABN AMRO's Sustainable Impact Fund put €100m (about $112m) into Dutch firm SL Materials, which recovers sand, gravel and cement from demolished concrete, to add capacity and sites. With cement about 8% of global CO2, circular building materials are drawing impact capital.

t: Crunchbase：2026年第三季全球创投1,590亿美元，十亿美元级大案创纪录
s: 第三季全球创投金额1,590亿美元，较第二季减25%、年增53%；27家公司单轮募资逾10亿美元创纪录，AI拿下1,020亿美元、占64%。前三季累计6,790亿美元为史上同期最高，资金高度集中于AI龙头。
te: Crunchbase: Global venture hits $159B in Q3 2026 with a record count of $1B+ rounds
se: Global venture funding reached $159B in Q3, down 25% from Q2 but up 53% year on year. A record 27 companies raised $1B+ rounds and AI took $102B, or 64%. The $679B nine-month total is the highest on record, showing capital piling into AI leaders.

t: 北美第三季新创募资920亿美元，季减35%但AI仍占三分之二
s: 美加新创第三季募得920亿美元，季减35%、年增50%，主因OpenAI与Anthropic本季未再有巨额融资；AI相关占610亿美元。辉达129亿美元并购Hugging Face居首，17家创投支持企业IPO仅募近40亿美元。
te: North American startup funding falls to $92B in Q3 as AI giants eye IPOs
se: US and Canadian startups raised $92B in Q3, down 35% from Q2 but up 50% year on year, largely because OpenAI and Anthropic had no new mega-raises. AI took $61B. Nvidia's $12.93B Hugging Face deal led M&A, while 17 venture-backed IPOs raised under $4B.

t: 欧洲第三季创投250亿美元，创四年来最佳单季
s: 欧洲第三季创投达250亿美元，年增77%；AI占75%（188亿美元）创新高，国防、资料中心、能源等实体科技约占一半。英国75亿美元居首，德、法紧追；Mistral募35亿美元为欧洲史上最大创投轮。
te: Europe posts $25B Q3, its strongest venture quarter in four years
se: European startups raised $25B in Q3, up 77% year on year. AI took a record 75% ($18.8B), and physical tech such as defense, data centers and energy made up about half. The UK led with $7.5B, ahead of Germany and France; Mistral's $3.5B was Europe's largest venture round ever.

t: 与Meta分手后首轮融资：中国AI代理新创Manus募逾5亿美元
s: AI代理新创Manus完成逾5亿美元融资，由博裕资本与IDG领投、腾讯与红杉中国（HSG）跟投。Meta原以20亿美元收购，4月遭中国当局要求撤销；此轮显示中国资本接手AI人才与技术，公司并考虑赴港上市。
te: China's Manus raises over $500M in first round since Meta deal collapsed
se: AI agent startup Manus raised over $500M led by Boyu Capital and IDG Capital, with Tencent and HSG joining. Meta's $2B acquisition was unwound after Chinese authorities intervened in April. The round shows domestic capital stepping in; Manus is reportedly weighing a Hong Kong IPO.

t: Endeavor Catalyst第五号基金3.2亿美元关帐，加码亚洲等新兴市场
s: 创业家组织Endeavor旗下创投Endeavor Catalyst第五号基金以3.2亿美元关帐，管理资产突破8.5亿美元，将扩大布局亚洲与新兴创业市场。其亚洲已投44家、4,680万美元，但自2025年以来在亚洲尚无出场案例。
te: Endeavor Catalyst closes $320M Fund V, expanding focus on Asia
se: Endeavor Catalyst, the VC arm of Endeavor, closed Fund V at $320M, lifting AUM above $850M and widening its focus on Asia and other emerging startup markets. It has put $46.8M into 44 Asian companies but has had no liquidity events in Asia since 2025.

t: 美国医疗投资机构TCGX募得6亿美元，首档亚洲生技基金成立
s: 美国医疗创投TCGX为首档亚洲生命科学基金募得6亿美元承诺资金，投资涵盖各发展阶段、聚焦开发全球市场新药的亚洲生技公司，并在上海与香港设点，反映国际资金看好亚洲早期新药研发动能。
te: TCGX secures $600M for its first Asia life sciences fund
se: US healthcare investor TCGX secured $600M in commitments for TCGX Asia Life Sciences Fund I, backing Asian biotechs at all stages that develop drugs for global markets. It is opening offices in Shanghai and Hong Kong, signaling global capital's bet on Asia's early-stage drug discovery.

t: 本周美国十大融资：Axiom获20亿美元战略投资，AI与能源领跑
s: 美国10月3至9日十大融资中，Flex分拆的云端与电力基础设施公司Axiom获General Catalyst等20亿美元战略投资，企业价值375亿美元；TypeSafe AI募8.7亿美元，显示AI算力与能源仍是资金焦点。
te: Week's biggest US rounds: Axiom's $2B strategic deal leads AI and energy lineup
se: In the Oct. 3–9 top-10 list, Flex spinout Axiom, a cloud and power infrastructure firm, drew a $2B strategic investment from General Catalyst and Koch Equity at a $37.5B initial enterprise value. TypeSafe AI raised $870M and quantum firm Oratomic $475M, as compute and energy keep attracting capital.

t: 企业支出管理新创Ramp募18.5亿美元，估值上看600亿美元
s: 据彭博报导，金融科技新创Ramp以约600亿美元投前估值募得约18.5亿美元，由Dragoneer与Thrive Capital领投。6月估值才440亿美元，四个月大增约160亿美元，反映资金持续追捧高成长AI金融科技。
te: Ramp raises about $1.85B at a roughly $60B valuation
se: Fintech Ramp raised about $1.85B at a roughly $60B valuation before the new money, Bloomberg reported, led by Dragoneer and Thrive Capital with Founders Fund investing heavily. It was valued at $44B in June, a ~$16B jump in four months; annualised revenue topped $1.5B by June.

t: 第三季台湾新创仅4笔重大募资，晶智达3.4亿元居冠
s: Meet盘点2026年第三季重大募资仅4笔，远低于首季14笔、次季10笔，总额约6.7亿元。晶智达获达盈领投、国发基金跟投3.4亿元，FUNNOW获和泰约3.18亿元C轮，资金明显集中于少数案件。
te: Taiwan startups log only four major rounds in Q3; iReach tops list at NT$340 million
se: Meet counted just four major Taiwanese startup rounds in Q3 2026, down from 14 in Q1 and 10 in Q2, totaling about NT$670 million. VCSEL maker iReach raised NT$340 million led by 达盈 with the National Development Fund, and FUNNOW took about NT$318 million from Hotai, showing capital concentrating in a few deals.

t: 量子点新创来成光子启动500万美元种子轮，半数获台湾半导体大厂表态
s: 2025年成立的来成光子以AI自动化合成短波红外线量子点墨水，可直接涂布于CMOS晶圆，估可让相机模组成本降10至100倍。种子轮目标500万美元，其中250万美元已获台湾一线半导体厂投资意向并进入签约，其余向海外募集。
te: Quantum-dot startup AilumiQ seeks US$5 million seed round, half pledged by a Taiwanese chip major
se: Founded in 2025, AilumiQ uses AI-driven automated synthesis to make short-wave infrared quantum-dot ink that coats directly onto CMOS wafers, claiming 10–100x lower camera-module costs. It targets a US$5 million seed round; US$2.5 million has investment intent from a top-tier Taiwanese semiconductor firm and is nearing signing, with the rest sought overseas.

t: 台北AI算力商KONST完成3,000万美元B轮，威刚领投
s: 总部在台北的KONST完成3,000万美元B轮，由威刚领投，摩比和协、和鼎创投等企业投资人参与。资金将扩大亚洲AI资料中心建置并推进“Token Factory”布局，凸显记忆体、电子制造业者以策略投资卡位AI算力供应链。
te: Taipei AI compute operator KONST raises US$30 million Series B led by ADATA
se: Taipei-headquartered KONST closed a US$30 million Series B led by ADATA, joined by corporate investors including M Mobility and Pegatron Venture Capital. It will expand AI data center buildout across Asia and push its Token Factory strategy, a sign that memory and electronics makers are using strategic stakes to secure a place in the AI compute supply chain.

t: 生技产值8,301亿元，医疗新创募资件数与金额却双降
s: 勤业众信陈重成指出，2025年台湾生技产业营收8,301亿元、年增7.05%，但健康医疗新创募资126件、6.6亿美元，件数与金额分别减11%、16%。获投新创年龄中位数升至5至6年，资金被AI与半导体吸走，新创须提早规划商业化。
te: Biotech revenue hits NT$830.1 billion, but health startup deals and funding both fall
se: Deloitte Taiwan's Chen Chung-cheng said Taiwan's biotech revenue reached NT$830.1 billion in 2025, up 7.05%, yet health startups closed 126 deals worth US$660 million, down 11% in count and 16% in value. The median age of funded firms rose to 5–6 years as AI and chips draw capital away, so startups must plan commercialization earlier.

t: 政院通过中小微企业转型升级条例，8年千亿元并增新创专章
s: 行政院10月8日通过“中小微企业转型升级发展条例”草案，经济部8年投入1,000亿元，并新增“新创企业培育专章”。研发投资抵减率提高至20%，转型设备抵减门槛降至25万元。草案送立法院审议，将影响新创取得资源的管道。
te: Cabinet approves SME upgrade act with NT$100 billion over eight years and a new startup chapter
se: On October 8 the Executive Yuan approved a draft act on transforming and upgrading small, medium and micro enterprises, with NT$100 billion from the economics ministry over eight years and a new chapter on startup incubation. The R&D tax credit rate rises to 20% and the equipment credit threshold drops to NT$250,000. The bill now goes to the legislature.

t: 创新板股票首度可发权证，4档14支权证10月6日上市
s: 证交所9月30日宣布权证新制，开放创新板股票作为权证标的，富田、联友金属、熙特尔、微矽电子4档符合资格，共14支权证于10月6日上市。发行额度上限等调整给3个月缓冲，2027年1月1日生效，有助提升创新板流动性。
te: Innovation Board stocks become warrant underlyings, with 14 warrants on four names listing Oct. 6
se: TWSE announced warrant rule changes on Sept. 30 that let Taiwan Innovation Board stocks serve as underlyings. Four Innovation Board stocks qualified, and 14 warrants listed on Oct. 6. Changes to issuance caps get a three-month grace period and take effect Jan. 1, 2027, a step expected to improve liquidity on the startup-oriented board.

t: 2026 Meet Neo Star 30强出炉：AI进传产、生而全球成主轴
s: 第15届Meet Neo Star从2024年9月至2026年7月采访逾200家新创中选出30强，观察四大趋势：AI协助传产自动化、一出生就瞄准国际并获a16z与YC等投资、AI走入实体硬体的深科技，以及研究成果加速商业化。
te: 2026 Meet Neo Star 30 named: AI for traditional industry and born-global teams lead
se: The 15th Meet Neo Star list picked 30 startups from more than 200 interviewed between September 2024 and July 2026. It highlights four trends: AI automating traditional industries, born-global teams backed by investors such as a16z and Y Combinator, deep tech as AI moves into hardware, and faster lab-to-market commercialization.

t: 蔡英文旧金山会晤新创与创投，吁台湾与矽谷双向连结
s: 前总统蔡英文卸任后首度访美，10月9日在旧金山台北经文处与年轻科技创业者及创投人士座谈，呼吁台湾与矽谷建立双向连结，鼓励旅外人才分享台湾故事，并带回技术、人才与投资的新观点，凸显矽谷台湾创业圈的角色。
te: Tsai meets start-up founders and VCs in San Francisco, urges two-way Taiwan–Silicon Valley ties
se: On her first US trip since leaving office, former president Tsai Ing-wen met young tech founders and venture capital figures at TECO San Francisco on Oct. 9. She called for two-way ties between Taiwan and Silicon Valley and urged Taiwanese abroad to bring home insights on technology, talent and investment, underscoring the role of the Bay Area founder community.

t: 金管会松绑：银行家族办公室顾问业务可走出高雄专区，首波11家银行符合资格
s: 金管会发布银行办理家族办公室顾问业务规范，在高雄专区试办满一年的银行可申请扩至全台分行，首波11家符合。专区内17家银行至8月底已服务239位客户、管理资产1,074亿元。家办服务从特区试点走向全台常态化。
te: Taiwan FSC lets banks take family office advisory beyond the Kaohsiung zone; 11 banks qualify
se: Taiwan's FSC issued rules allowing banks that have run family office advisory in the Kaohsiung zone for at least a year to offer it at branches island-wide; 11 banks qualify. The zone's 17 banks served 239 clients with NT$107.4bn in assets by end-August. The pilot is becoming a nationwide business line.

t: 物价累计涨幅破10%　明年遗产税免税额可望升至1,488万元、赠与税272万元
s: 8月CPI累计涨幅11.61%，超过10%门槛，遗产税免税额可望由1,333万元升至至少1,488万元，赠与税年免税额由244万元升至272万元，适用2027年起案件。财政部年底依10月CPI定案，影响家族赠与规划。
te: Taiwan's estate and gift tax exemptions set to rise in 2027 as CPI trigger is crossed
se: Cumulative CPI growth hit 11.61% through August, past the 10% trigger, so Taiwan's estate tax exemption is expected to rise from NT$13.33m to at least NT$14.88m and the annual gift exemption from NT$2.44m to NT$2.72m for 2027 cases. The Finance Ministry will confirm figures at year-end, reshaping family gifting plans.

t: 新加坡金管局研议将保单与数位支付代币纳入单一家办免税“指定投资”清单
s: 新加坡副总理兼金管局主席颜金勇在WMI全球家族办公室峰会表示，金管局正研议业界建议，将保单与数位支付代币纳入基金税务优惠的“指定投资”清单，实施日期另行公布。新加坡私人银行客户资产五年增约五成，显示其持续扩大家办诱因。
te: MAS weighs adding insurance policies and digital payment tokens to SFO tax-exempt investment list
se: Singapore Deputy PM and MAS chairman Gan Kim Yong told a Wealth Management Institute summit that MAS is reviewing industry calls to add insurance policies and digital payment tokens to the Designated Investment list used for fund tax incentives, including those for single family offices. Timing will come later; private banking assets grew about 50% in five years.

t: 日经：中国收紧离岸信托税制　中资家办由新加坡回流香港
s: 据日经亚洲分析，中国7月改革离岸信托税制，每个环节课20%税，加上新加坡洗钱案后审查趋严、家办核准逾一年，中资转向香港。新加坡单一家办逾2,000家，香港达3,384家，港府目标2028年前再引进220家。
te: Chinese family office wealth shifts from Singapore back to Hong Kong, Nikkei reports
se: Citing Nikkei Asia, the report says China's July overhaul taxing offshore trusts at 20% per stage, plus Singapore's tighter source-of-funds checks and year-long approvals after a S$3bn laundering case, is pushing Chinese wealth back to Hong Kong. Singapore has over 2,000 SFOs versus 3,384 in Hong Kong, which targets 220 more by 2028.

t: 摩根大通调查：74%国际家办视AI为首要投资主题　地缘风险最令人担忧
s: 摩根大通私人银行调查125家国际家办，74%将AI列为首要投资主题，66%最担心地缘政治风险。过去半年25%加码公开股票，43%新增另类资产配置，银行称属策略性转向而非例行再平衡，基础建设以36%居次。
te: JP Morgan pulse survey: 74% of international family offices make AI a top priority
se: JP Morgan Private Bank's pulse survey of 125 international family offices found 74% rank AI a top priority and 66% see geopolitics as the biggest portfolio risk. Over six months, 25% added to public equities and 43% made new allocations to alternatives, which the bank called a strategic shift; infrastructure (36%) ranked next.

t: 德银新加坡家办论坛现场调查：73%认为亚洲最稳定，AI风险意识大增
s: 德意志银行在新加坡举办第三届亚洲新兴市场家办论坛，约200名家办与富裕人士出席。现场调查显示，37%视利率与殖利率为全球成长最大风险，选AI者由去年5%升至17%；73%认为未来一年亚洲地缘最稳定，美国仅14%。
te: Deutsche Bank Singapore family office forum poll: 73% see Asia as most stable region
se: At Deutsche Bank's third Asia Emerging Markets Family Office Forum in Singapore, attended by about 200 families and wealthy individuals, 37% named rates and yields the top growth risk and AI's share jumped to 17% from 5% last year. 73% picked Asia as the most geopolitically stable region versus 14% for the US.

t: RBC与Campden报告：北美家办半数无完整接班计划，86%投资私募市场
s: RBC与Campden Wealth调查155家美洲家办，平均净资产约22.5亿美元。23%过去五年经历世代交接，但半数接班计划不完整或付之阙如；86%投资私募市场，直接投资占私募配置45%。显示传承治理仍落后于投资布局。
te: North American family offices upbeat, but half lack a full succession plan: RBC/Campden
se: The RBC and Campden Wealth survey of 155 family offices in the Americas (average net worth about US$2.25bn) found 23% had a generational transfer in the past five years, yet half have an incomplete or no succession plan. 86% invest in private markets, with direct deals 45% of that allocation.

t: Raffles家族办公室基金会捐25万星元　资助新加坡管理大学生海外创业实习
s: 港新双总部的联合家办Raffles Family Office旗下慈善基金会，在新加坡管理大学设立创新奖，五年共25万星元（约19.5万美元），每学年资助10名大学部学生海外实习，培养创业思维与国际视野。家办以慈善投入人才培育。
te: Raffles Family Office Foundation funds S$250,000 overseas internship award at SMU
se: The philanthropic arm of Raffles Family Office, a multi-family office headquartered in Hong Kong and Singapore, set up an S$250,000 (about US$195,000) five-year award at Singapore Management University, funding 10 undergraduates a year for overseas internships to build entrepreneurial skills. It shows family office giving aimed at talent.

t: 纽约市审计长拟向三大退休基金提出50亿美元私募气候投资
s: 纽约市审计长Mark Levine将向NYCERS、TRS、BERS三支退休基金提出50亿美元私募市场气候解决方案投资机会，涵盖再生能源、电网与建筑减碳。市府退休基金规模近3,000亿美元，目标2035年气候投资378亿美元、2040年净零。
te: NYC Comptroller to propose $5 billion in new private-markets climate investments
se: NYC Comptroller Mark Levine plans to bring $5 billion of private-market climate deals to the NYCERS, TRS and BERS pension boards, spanning renewables, grids and building decarbonization. The ~$300 billion city pensions target $37.8 billion in climate investments by 2035 and net zero by 2040.

t: 摩根大通自然资本携手巴拉圭 启动2亿美元永续林业平台
s: J.P. Morgan Natural Capital与巴拉圭总统府、当地企业集团Grupo Robinson合作，投入约2亿美元建立永续林业平台，结合商业造林、原生林复育，并产出木材与碳权，预计2027年初开始拨款，凸显自然资产进入机构投资组合。
te: J.P. Morgan Natural Capital and Paraguay launch $200 million sustainable forestry platform
se: J.P. Morgan Natural Capital is partnering with Paraguay's Office of the President and local group Grupo Robinson on a roughly $200 million forestry platform combining commercial plantations, native forest restoration, timber and carbon credits. Deployment is due to start in early 2027, reflecting nature's rise as an institutional asset class.

t: 法国农业信贷成立自然资本部门 旗下Amundi推2亿欧元森林复育基金
s: 法国农业信贷集团成立自然资本部门，由Timothée Jaulin领军，初期聚焦欧洲森林；旗下资产管理公司Amundi推出森林生态复育基金Amundi Arbora Nova，长期目标2亿欧元，集团并独家洽购EcoTree多数股权，显示大型银行布局自然资本。
te: Crédit Agricole launches natural capital division; Amundi targets €200 million forest restoration fund
se: Crédit Agricole set up a Natural Capital division, Crédit Agricole Capital Naturel, headed by Timothée Jaulin and first focused on European forests. Its asset manager Amundi launched Amundi Arbora Nova, aiming to raise €200 million over time for forest restoration, and the group is in exclusive talks to buy a majority of EcoTree.

t: 荷兰Achmea携手ILX 为退休基金打造新兴市场债权影响力平台
s: 荷兰保险集团Achmea旗下资产管理公司与ILX合作，为荷兰退休基金设计新兴市场债权影响力投资工具，主要承接多边开发银行与开发金融机构的贷款，聚焦气候、生物多样性、健康与平等，规模未揭露，属公私资本衔接的混合模式。
te: Achmea and ILX team up on an emerging-markets debt impact platform for Dutch pensions
se: Achmea Investment Management and ILX Management are building an emerging-markets debt impact vehicle for Dutch pension funds, mainly holding loans originated by multilateral development banks and DFIs with explicit impact goals in climate, biodiversity, health and equality. Size was not disclosed; it is a model for linking public and private capital.

t: Actis推印度第四个再生能源平台Leo Energies 目标逾3GW
s: General Atlantic旗下Actis在印度成立再生能源平台Leo Energies，目标建构逾3GW风电、太阳能与储能组合，已签约收购约650MWp、横跨五个邦的运转中太阳能案场，并有长期购电合约；这是Actis在印度第四度复制并购整合策略。
te: Actis launches Leo Energies, its fourth Indian clean energy platform, targeting over 3GW
se: General Atlantic-owned Actis launched Leo Energies in India, aiming for a portfolio of over 3GW of wind, solar and storage. It has agreed to buy about 650MWp of operating solar across five states under long-term PPAs, marking Actis's fourth Indian renewables platform built through a buy-and-build approach.

t: TPG第二档气候私募基金募得100亿美元
s: 据彭博报导，TPG第二档气候私募基金TPG Rise Climate II募得100亿美元并于9月底截止募资；阿布达比气候投资机构Alterra投入约10亿美元。Rise Climate平台总承诺额达171亿美元，显示大型LP对能源转型仍具信心。
te: TPG raises $10 billion for its second climate private equity fund
se: TPG has raised $10 billion for TPG Rise Climate II, which was due to close to new money at end-September, Bloomberg reported. UAE-backed Alterra committed around $1 billion. The Rise Climate platform had $17.1 billion in total commitments as of August, a sign large LPs still back the energy transition.

t: 英国FCA放弃强制气候揭露 改采“遵循或解释”
s: 英国金融行为监理总署FCA放弃上市公司强制气候揭露，改将UK SRS S1与S2全面采“遵循或解释”，保留范畴三宽限；新制适用2027年1月1日起的会计期间、2028年首度申报，可能削弱投资人取得一致气候资讯。
te: UK FCA drops mandatory IFRS-based climate reporting in favour of comply-or-explain
se: The FCA scrapped plans to make climate disclosures mandatory for UK listed companies, applying comply-or-explain to all UK SRS S1 and S2 requirements while keeping Scope 3 relief. Rules cover periods from 1 January 2027, with first reports in 2028, which may leave investors with patchier climate data.

t: 越南加入GSG Impact，成第44个国家伙伴、亚太第13个
s: Vietnam Impact Alliance成为GSG Impact第44个国家伙伴、亚太第13个，使GSG Impact Partnership涵盖国家增至49个；将串连政府、投资人、企业与公民社会发展影响力经济，回应越南气候转型与包容性成长的资金需求。
te: Vietnam becomes GSG Impact's 44th National Partner and 13th in Asia Pacific
se: Vietnam Impact Alliance became GSG Impact's 44th National Partner and the 13th in Asia Pacific, taking the GSG Impact Partnership to 49 countries. It will convene government, investors, business and civil society to build Vietnam's impact economy as the country seeks capital for its climate transition and inclusive growth.

t: 德国燃料电池新创Reverion完成1.75亿美元B轮 多家影响力投资人参与
s: 德国固态氧化物燃料电池新创Reverion完成1.75亿美元B轮，由Kembara领投，Aurum Impact、Carbon Equity等影响力投资人跟投；电厂发电效率达74.2%，搭配生质气与碳封存可达负排放，产能将扩大十倍至250MW。
te: Reverion raises $175 million Series B for carbon-negative-capable power plants
se: German fuel-cell startup Reverion raised a $175 million Series B led by Kembara, joined by Energy Impact Partners, Aurum Impact and Carbon Equity among others. Its plants reach 74.2% electrical efficiency and can deliver negative emissions with biogas and carbon storage; it plans a tenfold capacity jump to 250 MW.

t: Mandiant创办人新创Armadin完成2.55亿美元B轮，估值逾25亿美元
s: 资安新创Armadin完成2.555亿美元B轮，由a16z与Accel共同领投，估值逾25亿美元，累计募资达4.45亿美元，距离脱离隐身模式仅约七个月。以AI代理自动化攻击测试的资安平台，正成为创投追逐的热门赛道。
te: Armadin, Kevin Mandia's agentic security startup, raises $255.5M Series B at $2.5B+ valuation
se: Armadin closed a $255.5M Series B co-led by a16z and Accel, valuing it above $2.5B and lifting total funding to $445M, roughly seven months after leaving stealth. Investors are betting heavily on AI agents that probe enterprise defenses like attackers.

t: 租屋与医疗AI新创EliseAI募资3.5亿美元，估值40亿美元
s: 服务租屋与医疗业的AI新创EliseAI募得3.5亿美元，由a16z与Bessemer领投，估值达40亿美元；年度经常性收入6月已突破2亿美元，营收连续五年年增翻倍。显示垂直领域AI应用已能以营收撑起高估值。
te: EliseAI raises $350M at a $4B valuation
se: EliseAI raised $350M led by a16z and Bessemer at a $4B valuation, after passing $200M in annual recurring revenue in June and doubling revenue for five straight years. It shows vertical AI apps can now justify unicorn-plus prices with real revenue.

t: 以色列国防科技创投Protego完成首档1.25亿美元基金
s: Protego Ventures首档基金以1.25亿美元完成募集（首次关帐7,000万美元），专投技术经实战验证的以色列国防新创；投资组合XTEND已以15亿美元估值于纽约证交所上市，二号基金将扩大美国布局。
te: Protego Ventures closes debut $125M fund for Israeli defense tech
se: Protego Ventures, founded by Lital Leshem and Lee Moser, completed its $125M Fund I ($70M at first closing plus $55M) to back battle-tested Israeli defense startups. Portfolio firm XTEND listed on the NYSE at a $1.5B valuation; Fund II will lean into the US.

t: 印度第三季新创募资22亿美元年增5%，投资人转趋挑剔
s: Inc42统计，印度新创第三季募资22亿美元、年增5%，交易数却降13%至210件；四笔亿美元级大案与A/B轮（年增38%）带动成长，AI类达4.38亿美元、年增265%，资金集中于少数标的。
te: India's Q3 startup funding edges up 5% to $2.2B as investors get selective
se: Indian startups raised $2.2B in Q3 2026, up 5% YoY, while deal count fell 13% to 210, per Inc42. Four $100M+ rounds and a 38% jump in Series A–B money drove growth; AI funding hit $438M, up 265%, as capital concentrates in fewer bets.

t: 南韩前九月创投投资破10兆韩元，创四年新高
s: 南韩新创今年前九个月获创投投资达10兆韩元（约74亿美元），为2022年科技荣景后首度突破此门槛；AI晶片、生技医疗（约2兆韩元）与机器人交易带动，平均单笔规模翻倍以上。外资创投与资产管理公司也加速进场。
te: Korea's VC investment tops ₩10 trillion in nine months, a four-year high
se: VC investment in South Korean startups reached ₩10 trillion ($7.4B) in the first nine months, crossing that mark for the first time since the 2022 boom. AI chips, biotech and healthcare (about ₩2 trillion) and robotics led, and average deal size more than doubled.

t: 韩国创投公司以大企业共生基金成立首档影响力母基金
s: 韩国创投公司（KVIC）9月30日宣布，运用KB金融集团捐入大中小企业共生合作基金的30亿韩元成立母基金，并将募集至少50亿韩元子基金投资影响力企业。此举源于施行令修法，首度让企业共生资金流入创投合伙。
te: Korea Venture Investment launches first fund of funds using corporate partnership money
se: Korea Venture Investment Corp. formed a fund of funds on Sept 30 using ₩3B that KB Financial Group put into a large-small business cooperation fund, aiming for at least ₩5B in sub-funds for impact companies. A revised enforcement decree now lets such corporate money flow into VC partnerships.

t: 传HarbourVest收购新加坡GIC十亿美元私募基金组合
s: 据报导，私募市场资产管理公司HarbourVest将以次级交易方式，买下新加坡主权基金GIC规模10亿美元的私募基金投资组合，取得多元化基金权益。亚洲大型LP持续透过次级市场调整私募配置，带动交易量成长。
te: HarbourVest reportedly buys GIC's $1B private fund portfolio in secondary deal
se: HarbourVest is reported to be acquiring a $1B portfolio of private fund stakes from Singapore sovereign fund GIC in a secondary transaction, giving it a diversified pool of fund interests. Large Asian LPs are increasingly using secondaries to rebalance private-market exposure.

t: 澳洲资料中心Firmus定价50亿美元IPO，估值两个月近三倍
s: Blackstone与Nvidia支持的澳洲资料中心商Firmus以每股11澳元定价50亿美元IPO，估值306亿美元，较8月初的105亿美元近三倍，10月23日在澳洲证交所挂牌；约300亿美元负债令部分基金经理却步。
te: Firmus prices $5B IPO as valuation nearly triples in two months, splitting investors
se: Blackstone- and Nvidia-backed Australian data-centre operator Firmus priced its $5B IPO at A$11 a share, for a $30.6B equity valuation, nearly triple its $10.5B mark in early August. It lists on the ASX on Oct 23, but ~$30B of debt and execution risk worry some fund managers.

t: 欧洲第三季新募21档创投基金，Index、Accel大额加码AI与国防
s: Vestbee盘点欧洲第三季新募21档创投基金：Index Ventures募20亿美元、Highland Europe第六期11亿欧元、Accel第九档欧洲基金8亿美元。AI仍是主轴，国防与军民两用资金持续扩大，Airbus等国防企业也成为LP。
te: Europe's Q3 VC fundraising: Index, Highland and Accel lead 21 new funds
se: Vestbee tallied 21 new European and CEE VC funds in Q3: Index Ventures raised $2B (its growth vehicle now $2.2B), Highland Europe €1.1B for Fund VI and Accel $800M for its ninth European fund. AI is the common thread, while defence and dual-use capital keeps growing, with Airbus among new LPs.

t: GMI Cloud 完成 2.23 亿美元 B 轮，另获 4.4 亿美元授信扩张全球算力
s: 台湾AI云端算力新创GMI Cloud完成2.23亿美元B轮，由ARCHIV领投、辉达与趋势科技等参投，并取得中国信托4.4亿美元授信，合计约6.63亿美元，将扩建全球资料中心并深化日本主权AI布局，是台湾AI基础设施新创少见的大型募资。
te: Taiwan-based GMI Cloud closes $223M Series B plus $440M credit facility
se: GMI Cloud, a Taiwan-based GPU cloud provider, closed a $223M Series B led by ARCHIV with Nvidia and Trend Micro participating, plus a $440M credit facility from ChinaTrust, about $663M in total. Funds will expand data centres globally and its sovereign AI push in Japan — a rare mega-raise for a Taiwanese infrastructure startup.

t: 资安新创 TRAPA 获日本 GMO 集团投资，攻防演练平台进军日本
s: 台湾资安新创菱镜TRAPA获日本上市公司GMO网路集团旗下GMO Cybersecurity by Ierae策略投资，对方取得攻防演练平台TRAPA CYBER RANGE日本独家代理。TRAPA已服务逾百家大型企业，此案是其首度跨足海外市场。
te: Security startup TRAPA wins investment from Japan's GMO group to enter Japan
se: Taiwanese cybersecurity startup TRAPA received a strategic investment from GMO Cybersecurity by Ierae, part of listed GMO Internet Group, which gains exclusive Japan rights to its TRAPA CYBER RANGE drill platform. Serving 100+ large enterprises at home, TRAPA makes Japan its first overseas market.

t: 联齐 NextDrive 夺日本 HEMS 市占第一，东证 IPO 辅导持续推进
s: 台湾能源物联网新创联齐NextDrive以42.9%拿下日本HEMS闸道器市占第一，远超第二名的25.7%，并连续三年入选东证“Asia Startup Hub”，东证动员逾62家金融机构协助其在日上市，是台湾新创赴日IPO的指标案例。
te: NextDrive tops Japan's HEMS gateway market as it advances toward a TSE IPO
se: Taiwanese energy-IoT startup NextDrive holds 42.9% of Japan's HEMS gateway market, well ahead of the runner-up at 25.7%. Picked for the TSE Asia Startup Hub three years running, it has over 62 financial institutions mobilised to support a Tokyo listing — a bellwether for Taiwanese startups eyeing Japan IPOs.

t: 数发部百亿 AI 投资方案松绑，主要营运在台的境外公司也可纳投
s: 数发部“加强投资AI新创实施方案”放宽资格，在台研发、营收或员工占比达50%以上的境外公司也可获投。方案截至8月已投资10家，国发基金出资约2.55亿元、带动民间约5.7亿元，有助留住赴海外设控股的台湾AI团队。
te: MODA's NT$10B AI startup investment plan opens to offshore firms operating mainly in Taiwan
se: Taiwan's digital ministry widened its NT$10B AI startup co-investment plan to offshore companies with at least 50% of R&D, revenue or staff in Taiwan. By August it had backed 10 firms with about NT$255M from the National Development Fund, drawing some NT$570M in private money — a bid to keep Taiwanese AI teams with overseas holding structures in reach.

t: 4 家台湾新创入选《富比士亚洲》年度“100 to Watch”榜单
s: 第六届《富比士亚洲》“100 to Watch”榜单中，台湾有新析生物、科飞数位、欧姆佳科技与采风智汇4家入选，涵盖医疗、电动车软硬体与射频测试；其中新析7月完成2,000万美元A轮延伸、科飞年初完成430万美元Pre-A。
te: Four Taiwanese startups named to Forbes Asia's 100 to Watch list
se: Four Taiwanese startups made the 6th Forbes Asia 100 to Watch list: Syncell, KopherBit, Ohmplus Technology and AimFolds, spanning medtech, EV control systems and RF testing. Syncell closed a $20M Series A extension in July and KopherBit a $4.3M pre-A early this year, signalling regional recognition of Taiwan's deep tech.

t: 边缘 AI 检测新创 Overview 预估今年营收 3,000 万美元，研发团队移回台湾
s: 由台湾创办人参与共创的美商奥维达Overview，以边缘AI视觉检测切入制造业，预估2026年营收3,000万美元、年成长3倍，并于8月将研发团队移回台湾，在台员工逾40人；先前曾募得约1,300万美元A轮与过桥轮。
te: Edge-AI inspection startup Overview projects $30M revenue, moves R&D back to Taiwan
se: Overview, a US-registered edge-AI visual inspection company co-founded with a Taiwanese founder, projects 2026 revenue of $30M, tripling year on year, and in August moved its R&D team to Taiwan, now 40+ staff there. It earlier raised about $13M across Series A and bridge rounds.

t: YC Startup School 11 月首度来台，申请题目透露选人逻辑
s: 美国顶尖加速器Y Combinator将于11月12日在台北举办免费的Startup School，邀4位YC校友讲者，含DoorDash与Xendit创办人，涵盖MVP、成长与募资等课程；申请表重视实作成果与人脉，显示YC对台湾创业者的兴趣升温。
te: Y Combinator's Startup School comes to Taipei on Nov 12
se: Y Combinator will hold a free Startup School in Taipei on November 12, with four YC alumni speakers including founders from DoorDash and Xendit, covering MVPs, growth and fundraising. Its application stresses shipped work and founders' networks, a sign of YC's growing interest in Taiwanese founders.

t: 证交所携手 AAMA 办分享会，协助新创迈向创新板 IPO
s: 台湾证券交易所与AAMA合办“从IPO准备到市场沟通”分享会，吸引17家、约23位企业代表参加，涵盖AI、生医与云端等领域，并邀9月22日挂牌创新板的新创创办人现身说法，持续为创新板培养上市案源。
te: TWSE teams up with AAMA to coach startups on Taiwan Innovation Board IPOs
se: The Taiwan Stock Exchange and AAMA held a session on moving from IPO preparation to investor communication, drawing 17 companies and about 23 representatives from AI, biotech and cloud. A founder whose company listed on the Taiwan Innovation Board on Sept 22 shared lessons, as TWSE works to build the board's listing pipeline.

t: 亚洲EAM转型科技平台 抢攻B2B SaaS商机
s: 亚洲外部资产管理机构（EAM）进入新一轮竞争，开始自建并对外输出专属科技平台，希望开拓B2B SaaS营收并扩大市占。显示EAM正从单纯投资顾问，转型为兼营财富科技服务的业者，也将改变家族办公室选择服务商的方式。
te: Asia's EAMs turn into tech platforms, chasing B2B SaaS revenue
se: Asia's external asset managers (EAMs) are entering a new phase of competition, building proprietary tech platforms and offering them to others in a bid to earn B2B SaaS revenue and win market share — a shift from pure advisory toward wealth-tech services that could change how family offices pick providers.

t: 渣打：公益是家族治理的“辅助轮”
s: 渣打全球私人银行亚洲慈善主管Scott Chang表示，结构化公益捐赠可作为家族治理与传承规划的“辅助轮”，让家族先透过公益对齐价值，再处理财富移转；他主张慈善不应被当成金融商品销售。
te: StanChart: philanthropy is 'training wheels' for family governance
se: Scott Chang, Asia philanthropy head at Standard Chartered Global Private Bank, says structured giving acts as 'training wheels' for family governance and succession, helping families align before discussing wealth transfer, and argues philanthropy should not be sold as a product.

t: 家族办公室资产规模已超越全球创投业
s: 单一家族办公室管理资产约5.5兆美元（花旗估计5.9至6.9兆），超越创投业的1至1.5兆美元；家族办公室数量自2020年增逾75%至10,700家以上，七成从事直接投资，正与私募股权、创投争抢案源。
te: Family offices now outsize the global VC industry
se: Single-family offices oversee about $5.5 trillion (Citi Wealth puts it at $5.9-6.9 trillion), above the $1-1.5 trillion venture industry. Their number has grown over 75% since 2020 to more than 10,700, and 70% make direct investments, competing with PE and VC for deals.

t: 信托公会推传承信托 安养信托规模逾2,075亿元
s: 信托公会9月24日办传承信托说明会，兆丰银、国泰世华分享实务。截至2026年6月，安养信托受益人逾22.7万人、受托金额逾新台币2,075亿元；台湾2025年底已进入超高龄社会，股权传承信托需求升温。
te: Taiwan Trust Association pushes succession trusts as elderly-care trusts top NT$207.5bn
se: Taiwan's Trust Association held a succession-trust briefing on Sept 24 with Mega Bank and Cathay United Bank. As of June 2026, elderly-care trusts had over 227,000 beneficiaries and more than NT$207.5 billion entrusted; with Taiwan super-aged since end-2025, equity succession trusts are drawing demand.

t: 出售事业获291亿美元 Kirsh家族扩建纽约家办
s: 富豪Natie Kirsh家族同意以291亿美元（含债务）将Jetro Restaurant Depot售予Sysco，对价含216亿美元现金及9,150万股Sysco股票；家族正扩建纽约家办，招募投资长与投资委员会成员。
te: After $29.1bn sale, Kirsh family builds out New York family office
se: After agreeing to sell Jetro Restaurant Depot to Sysco for $29.1 billion including debt ($21.6 billion cash plus 91.5 million Sysco shares), 94-year-old billionaire Natie Kirsh's family is expanding its New York office, recruiting a CIO, investment committee members and heads of public and private investments.

t: 家办9月出手变少但押注大轮次
s: Fintrx提供CNBC的数据显示，家办9月直接投资42笔，少于8月的52笔，但集中押注大轮次：Hillspire参与Mistral约34亿美元D轮，地热新创Mazama完成1.35亿美元B轮，反映家办偏好少而大的投资。
te: Family offices made fewer bets in September but backed big rounds
se: Family offices logged 42 direct company investments in September, down from 52 in August, per Fintrx data shared with CNBC, but backed large rounds: Hillspire joined Mistral's roughly $3.4 billion Series D, Duquesne backed Fab2 and Precision Neuroscience, and Mazama Energy raised a $135 million Series B.

t: 巴克莱私银：72%富裕投资人已布局私募市场
s: 巴克莱私人银行调查逾600位英、欧、亚、中东及非洲富裕投资人，72%已投资私募市场（2025年为50%），60%计划加码，但平均配置由30%降至27%；41%希望缩短锁定期，基础建设配置升至27%。
te: Barclays Private Bank: 72% of wealthy investors now in private markets
se: A Barclays Private Bank survey of 600-plus wealthy investors in the UK, Europe, Asia, the Middle East and Africa found 72% now invest in private markets (50% in 2025) and 60% plan to add more, though average allocations slipped from 30% to 27%; 41% want shorter lock-ups.

t: 连续受益人信托获政院共识 富过三代露曙光
s: 信托公会秘书长林志吉撰文指出，行政院跨部会协商已就“连续受益人信托”存续期间与课税原则达成共识，家族可结合有价证券信托兼顾股权控管与传承；文中并提及未来20至30年全球将有83兆美元财富跨代移转。
te: Taiwan Cabinet reaches consensus on successive-beneficiary trusts
se: Trust Association secretary-general Lin Chih-chi writes that a Cabinet inter-ministry review has reached consensus on the duration and tax principles of 'successive-beneficiary trusts', letting families pair securities trusts with control and succession; he notes $83 trillion will change generations globally within 20-30 years.

t: 美国气候政策退场之际，亚洲投资人接手气候融资主导权
s: 淡马锡、曹氏家族办公室等亚洲资金方表示，区域气候与绿色投资并未放缓；以亚太海洋新创为对象的 Asia Ocean Fund 目标规模 7,500 万美元、预计投资 30 家。
te: As the US retreats, Asia's investors take the lead on climate financing
se: Asian asset owners including Temasek and the Tsao Family Office say regional climate investing is pressing ahead; the Asia Ocean Fund targets $75M across 30 Asia-Pacific deals.

t: 性别视角投资转向公开市场，2X Global 目标 2027 年前新增 200 亿美元
s: 2X Global 蒙特娄年会聚集 44 国、270 位与会者，讨论将性别视角投资从私募延伸至公开股债市场；加拿大 FinDev Canada 同步宣布投入 3,000 万加元。
te: Gender-lens investors look to scale capital in public markets
se: At 2X Global's Montreal summit (270 participants from 44 countries), investors pushed to extend gender-lens strategies into public equities and debt, targeting $20B in new capital by 2027; FinDev Canada committed C$30M.

t: GIIN 共同创办人 Amit Bouri 卸任前受访：市场已达 1.5 兆美元，系统性进展仍不足
s: 领导全球影响力投资网络（GIIN）17 年的 Bouri 将于 10 月阿姆斯特丹年会后卸任；他指出市场规模已由 2019 年约 5,000 亿美元成长至 1.5 兆美元，但全球层面的系统性改变仍未到位。
te: GIIN's Amit Bouri reflects as he steps down after 17 years
se: Bouri, who led the GIIN for 17 years, steps down after the October Amsterdam forum; the market grew from about $500B (2019) to $1.5T, yet he says systemic progress remains insufficient.

t: 纽约气候周：McKnight 基金会推 1.5 亿美元基金，支持社区自有气候专案
s: McKnight 基金会在美国中西部七州盘点逾 110 个社区自有气候专案、总成本约 4.5 亿美元，并与伙伴设立 1.5 亿美元的 Power & Place 基金补足资金缺口；同期气候专业创投募资明显降温。
te: Climate Week NYC: McKnight backs a $150M fund for community-owned climate projects
se: McKnight Foundation mapped 110+ community-owned climate projects across seven Midwest states (about $450M in total cost) and helped launch the $150M Power & Place fund to close the gap, even as climate-specialist VC fundraising slows.

t: 日本影响力投资余额达18.65兆日圆，首届东京Impact Galleria串连亚洲十国生态系
s: 日本影响力投资余额已达约18.65兆日圆（约1,250亿美元），首届东京Impact Galleria汇集十国约300人；AVPN指出，亚洲的瓶颈不在资金，而在可投资的案源。
te: Japan's ¥18.65 trillion impact market anchors first Impact Galleria Tokyo, linking 10 Asian ecosystems
se: Japan's outstanding impact investments reached about ¥18.65 trillion (~$125bn), and the first Impact Galleria Tokyo drew some 300 participants from 10 countries. AVPN noted Asia's real bottleneck is bankable deals, not capital.

t: 全球500家开发银行2027年齐聚曼谷，Finance in Common峰会首度移师亚洲
s: 亚洲开发银行宣布将于2027年3月底在曼谷主办Finance in Common峰会，与会开发银行合计管理约23兆美元资产、年投资约2.5兆美元，亚洲公共资金撬动民间资本的平台角色将更吃重。
te: 500 development banks to meet in Bangkok as Finance in Common Summit comes to Asia for the first time
se: ADB will host the Finance in Common Summit in Bangkok from 31 March to 2 April 2027, the first in Asia, gathering 500+ public development banks managing roughly $23trn and investing about $2.5trn a year—raising Asia's profile as a hub for mobilising private capital.

t: 欧盟反漂绿新规上路：净零承诺须附验证计划，靠抵换不得标示“碳中和”
s: 欧盟EmpCo指令9月27日起适用，净零承诺须有可量化时程并经第三方验证，依赖碳抵换的产品不得再称碳中和；金融机关同受规范，惟截至6月仍有至少17国未完成转化立法。
te: EU greenwashing rules take effect: net-zero claims need verified plans, offset-based 'carbon neutral' labels banned
se: The EU's EmpCo Directive now applies: net-zero pledges need measurable, time-bound plans with independent verification, and offset-reliant products can no longer be labelled 'carbon neutral'. Banks are covered too, though at least 17 member states had not transposed it as of June.

t: Enable Ventures募得5,030万美元，专投身障科技并缩小财富落差
s: 以身障视角投资的创投Enable Ventures完成5,030万美元募资（原目标7,500万），福特基金会等参与；预计投资约24家早期公司，显示身障正成为新兴影响力投资主题。
te: Enable Ventures raises $50.3 million for disability-tech venture fund
se: Disability-lens VC Enable Ventures closed its fund at $50.3m (vs a $75m target), backed by the Ford Foundation, UnitedHealth Group and others. It has made 11 investments and plans about 24, signalling disability as an emerging impact theme.

t: Bessemer 完成 57.5 亿美元新基金，全面押注 AI 原生企业
s: 资金分为 17.5 亿美元种子与早期基金、40 亿美元成长基金，涵盖算力、基础模型到应用与 Agent 的 AI 全产业链。
te: Bessemer Venture Partners closes $5.75B for AI-native founders
se: The raise splits into $1.75B for seed/early stage and $4B for growth, targeting AI-native companies from infrastructure and models to apps and agents.

t: 本周全球十大募资：资安双雄 Island、Cyera 各募 4 亿美元
s: Island（估值 64 亿美元）与 Cyera 各完成 4 亿美元募资，Snorkel AI 以 32 亿美元估值募得 3.5 亿美元；资安、AI 与医疗科技主导本周大型交易。
te: The week's 10 biggest rounds: Island and Cyera lead with $400M each
se: Island ($6.4B valuation) and Cyera each raised $400M, while Snorkel AI raised $350M at $3.2B; security, AI and health dominated the week's megadeals.

t: 亿元级 A 轮成常态：2026 年至少 114 笔逾 1 亿美元 A 轮
s: 今年全球逾 1 亿美元的 A 轮至少 114 笔、合计约 330 亿美元，可望创历史新高；其中七成以上流向 AI 新创，约半数在美国。
te: Jumbo-sized Series A rounds are on the rise
se: At least 114 Series A rounds of $100M+ have closed globally in 2026, totaling roughly $33B and on pace for a record; over 70% went to AI startups.

t: OpenAI传洽谈至少300亿美元新一轮募资，估值上看1.4兆美元
s: 据Bloomberg报导，OpenAI正洽谈至少300亿美元的新一轮募资，估值约1.4兆美元，较3月的8,520亿美元大幅跃升；显示资金持续向头部AI模型公司高度集中，也为其明年上市铺路。
te: OpenAI reportedly in talks to raise $30B round at $1.4T valuation
se: OpenAI is reportedly negotiating a round of at least $30B at roughly a $1.4T valuation, up from $852B in March, underscoring how heavily capital is concentrating in frontier AI ahead of its expected listing next year.

t: 消费级AI代理Instinct完成10亿美元C轮，估值100亿美元
s: 代使用者订位、付款、采购的消费级AI代理新创Instinct，由Sequoia、Benchmark、Coatue投资完成10亿美元C轮，估值100亿美元，距上轮25亿美元估值仅约一个月，反映AI代理赛道的资金热度。
te: Viral AI agent Instinct raises $1B Series C at a $10B valuation
se: Consumer AI agent Instinct, which books travel, pays bills and shops for users, raised a $1B Series C from Sequoia, Benchmark and Coatue at a $10B valuation, about a month after a round at $2.5B, showing how fast capital is chasing AI agents.

t: 英国AI算力云Nscale赴美IPO前取得33.6亿美元可转债融资
s: Nvidia支持的英国AI云端业者Nscale，在纽约证交所IPO前由Third Point与Nvidia领投取得33.6亿美元可转债，上市后转为股权；预期估值约350亿美元，显示AI资料中心建置需要庞大资本。
te: Ahead of US IPO, British AI neocloud Nscale secures $3.36B in convertible financing
se: Nvidia-backed British AI cloud provider Nscale lined up $3.36B in convertible notes led by Third Point and Nvidia ahead of an NYSE listing expected to value it around $35B, illustrating the scale of capital needed for AI data center buildouts.

t: GCash母公司Mynt菲律宾IPO定价，募资约8.45亿美元
s: 菲律宾行动支付GCash母公司Mynt以每股6.6披索定价IPO，募资约530亿披索（约8.45亿美元），预计10月20日挂牌，基石投资人包括Capital Research与IFC；为东南亚金融科技出场的重要指标案。
te: GCash owner Mynt prices Philippine IPO at 6.6 pesos per share
se: Mynt, parent of Philippine e-wallet GCash, priced its IPO at 6.60 pesos a share to raise about 53B pesos (~$845M), with trading set for Oct. 20 and cornerstones including Capital Research and the IFC, a bellwether exit for Southeast Asian fintech.

t: 东南亚创投面临后续轮资金断层，扣除单一大案上半年募资反降21%
s: 东南亚2026上半年创投募资达72.5亿美元，但其中45亿美元来自DayOne单一C轮；扣除后实际下滑21%至27.5亿美元，A轮中位数也降至800万美元，中后期资金断层成为区域生态的结构性问题。
te: SE Asia venture capital grapples with structural gap in follow-on funding
se: Southeast Asian startups raised $7.25B in H1 2026, but $4.5B came from DayOne's single Series C; excluding it, funding fell 21% to $2.75B and median Series A size dropped to $8M, exposing a structural gap in growth-stage capital.

t: Lightspeed募集2.5亿美元新印度基金，聚焦早期AI
s: Lightspeed为第五期印度基金募集2.5亿美元、已取得八成承诺，锁定印度与东南亚早期AI新创；规模仅2022年前一期5亿美元的一半，反映亚洲创投转向更精实、重视个案品质的布局。
te: Lightspeed targets $250M for new India fund, focusing on early-stage AI
se: Lightspeed is raising $250M for its fifth India fund, with 80% already committed, to back early-stage AI startups in India and Southeast Asia; the fund is half the size of its $500M 2022 predecessor, signaling a leaner, more selective approach.

t: FunNow 获和泰汽车 1,000 万美元 C 轮投资，携手首攻日本市场
s: 即时预订平台 FunNow 完成约新台币 3.18 亿元 C 轮，将与和泰旗下旅游平台 chicTrip 整合服务，资金用于海外扩张与 AI 研发；公司已于 7 月签署上市辅导。
te: FunNow raises $10M Series C from Hotai Motor, targeting Japan
se: Instant-booking platform FunNow closed a ~NT$318M Series C from Hotai Motor, integrating with Hotai's chicTrip travel platform to expand into Japan and invest in AI; it entered IPO counseling in July.

t: 第四届渣打女力创业奖揭晓，长者送餐平台夺冠
s: 由渣打银行、立人社会福利基金会与 Impact Hub Taipei 合办，前三名为长者送餐照护、心辅犬训练与 AI 量身内衣平台；计划自 2023 年起已培育近 120 家女性创业团队。
te: Standard Chartered Women Entrepreneurship Award names its fourth-cohort winners
se: Co-run by Standard Chartered, the Lih Jen Foundation and Impact Hub Taipei, the award's top three were an elder meal-delivery platform, a service-dog team and an AI fit-tech brand; nearly 120 women-led teams have been trained since 2023.

t: LANDED 以 12 个月加速计划，协助台湾新创落地美国
s: 纽约台裔创业者黄圣安创办的 LANDED 采“市场验证、营收、募资”三阶段，自 2025 年起已辅导 9 家新创，其中保险科技 Qlo 入选 YC 2026 夏季梯次。
te: LANDED's 12-month program helps Taiwanese startups land in the US
se: Founded by New York-based Taiwanese entrepreneur Huang Sheng-an, LANDED runs a three-phase program (validation, revenue, fundraising) and has backed nine startups since 2025, including YC S26 insurtech Qlo.

t: 2026台湾新创投资趋势年报：去年投资额27.74亿美元，AI与半导体创新高
s: 经济部中小及新创企业署发布年报，2025年台湾新创投资共555件、27.74亿美元；AI募资5.69亿美元、年增近八成，半导体4.42亿美元亦增逾七成，显示资金高度集中于AI与晶片赛道。
te: Taiwan Startup Investment Hit US$2.774B in 2025 as AI and Chips Set Records
se: MOEA's SME and startup agency reported 555 deals worth US$2.774B in 2025, with AI startups raising US$569M (up ~80%) and semiconductors US$442M (up 70%+), showing capital concentrating in AI and chips.

t: 晶智达完成3.4亿元增资押注AI光通讯，达盈领投、国发基金跟投
s: VCSEL雷射厂晶智达完成新台币3.4亿元增资，由达盈领投、国发基金与光通讯策略投资人跟投，资金将扩充研发与测试能量，抢攻AI算力晶片间高速光互连，最快2027至2028年小量生产。
te: iReach Raises NT$340M for AI Optical Interconnect, with National Development Fund Joining
se: VCSEL maker iReach closed a NT$340M round led by Da-Ying, joined by the National Development Fund and optical-comms strategic investors, to expand R&D and testing for AI chip-to-chip optical interconnects, targeting small-volume output in 2027-28.

t: 棱研科技转创新板挂牌，首日上涨逾16%
s: 毫米波新创棱研科技（7812）9月22日由兴柜转台湾创新板上市，承销价60元、首日收70元，涨幅逾16%，为卫星、国防等非红供应链新创走向资本市场的指标案例。
te: TMYTEK Debuts on Taiwan Innovation Board, Gains Over 16% on First Day
se: Millimeter-wave startup TMYTEK (7812) moved from the emerging market to the Taiwan Innovation Board on Sept 22, closing at NT$70 versus a NT$60 offer price, a 16%+ gain and a marker for satellite and defense startups reaching public markets.

t: 金管会、国发会“创新大步计划”TiBOOST延长征件至10月5日
s: 由金管会与国发会指导、证交所主办的TiBOOST创新大步计划，截至9月29日已收逾百件申请、约半数来自19国的海外团队，征件延至10月5日，旨在为AI新创串接资金与产业资源。
te: FSC-NDC TiBOOST Program for AI Startups Extends Application Deadline to Oct 5
se: The TiBOOST program, backed by the FSC and NDC and run by TWSE, drew 100+ applications by Sept 29, about half from 19 countries abroad, and extended its deadline to Oct 5 to link AI startups with capital and industry partners.

t: 鸿海董事长刘扬伟公开五大准则，揭露集团新创投资成绩
s: 刘扬伟以产业时机、团队执行力、策略综效、可沟通性与投后退场规划五准则筛选新创；鸿海2019年以来直接策略投资33家、20家成功，旗下五支基金投资594家、321家成功，并设三年检视机制。
te: Foxconn Chairman Young Liu Lays Out Five Criteria for Startup Investing
se: Young Liu said Foxconn screens startups on timing, execution, synergy, explainability and exit planning; since 2019 its direct strategic bets show 20 successes out of 33, while its five funds count 321 out of 594, under a three-year review rule.

t: 国发会矽谷设首个海外揽才据点，Taiwan Demo Day 12家新创登场
s: 国发会在矽谷新创基地设立Talent Taiwan首个海外办公室，同期揽才活动吸引逾3,000人、14家台企参与，另有12家新创于Demo Day登场，强化国际人才与资金链结。
te: NDC Opens First Overseas Talent Office in Silicon Valley, 12 Startups Pitch at Taiwan Demo Day
se: The NDC opened Talent Taiwan's first overseas office inside its Startup Island TAIWAN Silicon Valley hub; a parallel Career Day drew 3,000+ attendees and 14 Taiwanese firms, while 12 startups pitched at Taiwan Demo Day.

t: 花旗：亚太家族办公室直接投资与 AI 布局领先全球
s: 花旗 2026 全球家族办公室报告亚太篇显示，79% 参与直接投资、80% 将 AI 列为主要布局产业，均居全球之冠；26% 今年以来报酬逾 15%。
te: Citi: Asia-Pacific family offices lead in direct investing and AI
se: Citi's 2026 survey found 79% of APAC family offices invest directly and 80% name AI a primary sector focus, both the highest globally; 26% report YTD returns above 15%.

t: TMF Group：家办转向多司法管辖区布局，新加坡、香港受瞩目
s: 仅 31% 家办以接近投资资产为选址首要考量，政治与经济稳定各占 23%；多数家办不再整体迁移，而是随业务扩张增设据点，新加坡与香港皆为区域枢纽。
te: TMF Group: family offices rethink how they choose jurisdictions
se: Only 31% of family offices pick a jurisdiction mainly for proximity to assets, with political and economic stability at 23% each; most now add jurisdictions rather than relocate, with Singapore and Hong Kong as key hubs.

t: 凯雷延揽两位高阶主管，扩大家族办公室业务
s: 凯雷延揽 David Seeberan 出任全球家族办公室部门主管、前贝莱德的 Victoria Matthews 负责欧洲与亚洲，呼应其 2028 年前向高资产客群募集逾 2,000 亿美元的目标。
te: Carlyle hires two executives to lead its family office business
se: Carlyle named David Seeberan global head of its family office group and ex-BlackRock Victoria Matthews to lead Europe and Asia, supporting its goal of raising $200B+ from private wealth by 2028.

t: RBC与Campden北美家办报告：流动性受困、家族与非家族高管薪酬落差扩大
s: RBC与Campden Wealth调查155家北美家办：近半私募基金投资人未能如期退出；非家族CEO年薪72.1万美元，远高于家族CEO的46万美元，凸显流动性与人才定价成治理焦点。
te: RBC–Campden North America Family Office Report flags liquidity squeeze and pay gap
se: RBC and Campden Wealth's survey of 155 North American family offices found nearly half of private-fund investors could not exit as planned, while non-family CEOs earn $721,000 versus $460,000 for family CEOs, putting liquidity and talent pricing at the center of family office governance.

t: 新加坡MAS单一家办新框架上路，联合家办执行长：外部资产管理机构被推向2,000万星元以下市场
s: 管理约14亿美元的Rockstead Capital执行长Lester Tay指出，MAS简化单一家办设立的新框架有利私人银行，恐将精品型外部资产管理机构挤向2,000万星元以下客群。
te: MAS SFO framework tilts field to private banks, pushing EAMs to sub-S$20m market, says MFO chief
se: The CEO of Rockstead Capital, a multi-family office with about US$1.4bn in assets, said requirements in MAS's streamlined single-family office framework favour private banks and could push boutique external asset managers toward families with under S$20m.

t: 家族传承服务 成国银竞争下个战场
s: AI产业链带动企业主财富扩张，公股银行转攻亿元级高资产客群；兆丰银高资产客户达2,232户、年增19%，管理资产逾2,640亿元、年增25%，并以“投资、融资、传承”为主轴，家族传承成财管新战场。
te: Family succession services become Taiwan state-run banks' next battleground
se: With AI supply-chain wealth swelling, Taiwan's state-run banks are chasing ultra-wealthy clients; Mega Bank's high-net-worth clients rose 19% to 2,232 with AUM above NT$264bn (+25%), as it builds around investment, financing and succession.

t: Northwestern Mutual推出家族办公室服务，锁定净资产5,000万美元以上客群
s: 美国Northwestern Mutual推出整合法律、税务、投资、慈善与传承规划的家族办公室服务，门槛为净资产5,000万美元，由40余名内部专家支援顾问；反映大型金融机构加速将家办能力产品化。
te: Northwestern Mutual launches Family Office Services for $50m-plus clients
se: Northwestern Mutual rolled out Family Office Services combining legal, tax, investment, philanthropy and legacy planning for clients worth at least $50m, backed by 40-plus in-house specialists, as large firms productise family office capabilities.

t: Wealth Enhancement并购RWA Wealth Partners，强化超高资产家族办公室服务
s: Wealth Enhancement将收购客户资产约224.6亿美元的RWA Wealth Partners，合并后逾1,871亿美元，藉其信托、遗产规划与家族治理能力补强超高资产客群服务。
te: Wealth Enhancement to acquire RWA Wealth Partners, bolstering UHNW family office offering
se: Wealth Enhancement agreed to buy Boston-based RWA Wealth Partners, with about $22.46bn in client assets, lifting combined assets above $187.1bn and adding trust, estate and family governance expertise for its $25m-plus client tier.

t: Americana Partners成立联合家族办公室业务
s: 管理资产121亿美元的Americana Partners成立联合家族办公室部门，整合今年收购的NRT Consulting会计能力，服务美国与拉美超高资产家族的跨世代规划需求。
te: Americana Partners launches multi-family office business
se: Americana Partners, with $12.1bn in assets, launched a multi-family office unit led by Matt Celenza, folding in accounting capabilities from its 2026 NRT Consulting acquisition to serve US and Latin American UHNW families needing coordinated multigenerational planning.
